description: Follow the release check of a publish: its status, each check's run with its checker, effect, and status, each blocking result with the file and line or package, the rule, and how to fix it, what deploy did with the release, and what to do next. Omit check_id for the service's latest check. Call it again shortly while deploy_state is waiting: a passed check's release goes live, and a blocked or errored one's is refused, shortly after. Requires connecting a Valet account.

check_id.description: The check's id, from a publish. Omit to read the service's latest check.

name.description: Required. The website's, app's, or agent's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: get_check
title: Get a release check
